inventory.objective: Equals expresses equal value on both sides, not a direction to output an answer.
inventory.demo: Two equalsScene examples8+4=□+5 and6+3=□+4; wrong-box total before count-up to valid part.
inventory.hints: Compute complete left value; account for fixed part on right; compensation decreases second term when first increases.
inventory.audit: LESSON_AUDIT.md145 and785–787: concept misconception, animation and level; historical technical reports not independently repeated.
inventory.coverageDifference: COVERAGE144/332 and1006–1009 omit level and still report2demos correctly. Executable source inventory takes precedence.
inventory.extends: Original numeric bars with uniform unit length, direct optional model value, both orientations/reflexivity/zero, three independently entered slots allowing repeated valid values, numeric compensation allowing any valid mental method.
inventory.corrected: Do not label conceptual bar lengths as measured mass. No mandatory count-up/model sequence or no-total-calculation restriction.
inventory.limits: No graph/Lite source edits; no solving-variable procedure or physical balance skill inferred.
